create_InputBlock: create an InputBlock module to featurize molecular graph input data into edge and global embeddings
build_atomic_embedding: build an atomic number embedding layer that maps element indices to hidden-size vectors using uniform initialization
run_forward_pass: run the InputBlock forward pass on GraphAttentionData to compute neighbor embeddings from node and edge features
review_charge_spin_embedding: review the charge and spin embedding layers that use ChgSpinEmbedding to encode molecular charge and spin states
test_edge_attr_linear: test the edge attribute linear layer that processes edge distance and direction expansion features into hidden-size embeddings
